title: Provider integration contract: optional providers are opt-in, supplemental, unscored evidence
rationale: trellis-06f8 (plan pl-43c5 step 1) fixed the contract in SPEC §16 before any implementation: providers are pinned local tools (jscpd, dependency-cruiser, Knip; SonarJS gated) that run only on explicit opt-in and never score. Five states (unrequested/unavailable/unsupported/incomplete/complete) with no invented zero-metrics for absent execution; observed coverage asserted from provider evidence, never exit status. Provider failure is located unavailable/incomplete evidence: violated declarative requirement exits 2, invalid config/inability to run stays exit 1. Explicitly enabled external execution may use trellis-owned isolated temp scratch with cleanup and never writes the target; no executable target config or arbitrary command strings. Native pl-b2ea scoring stays authoritative; backend promotion or new weights need a separately versioned calibration. The shared-parser/subprocess restrictions are narrowed for optional slots only — no-model, no-target-command, no-audit-time-download and default-offline guarantees unchanged. Sonar gated on a documented distribution decision (trellis-db3e).
